analyst.summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare runs a fast-growing chain of Ayurvedic hospitals and clinics across India, and its most recent full year showed very strong growth in both revenue and profit as the network of centres expanded, with excellent returns on capital. The company continues to open new centres and launch new products. The stock is not cheaply priced relative to its book value, reflecting how much the market already likes this growth story. We rate it a Hold: a genuine, broad-based growth story already reflected in a rich valuation.
